issues.where: left limb of planet, about 115,580 (crop O)
issues.what: a stray warm lens-flare blob sits right on the dark-side limb. It has no light source on that side and reads as a pasted object
issues.fix: remove the flare ghost, or move it onto the line from the sun through the frame centre and make it much fainter

issues.where: sun limb and corona, upper right (crops C, M, S)
issues.what: the sun disc is blown out and looks airbrushed with no granulation. The corona filaments look painted, and there is a darker doubled ring between the disc edge and the outer glow
issues.fix: add surface granulation and limb darkening, and make the glow fall off smoothly from the disc edge with no dark ring

issues.where: Milky Way band, upper left (crops B, G, H, N)
issues.what: the dust lane looks like a blotchy, painterly smear with even clumps of stars pasted on it. At native size it reads as a texture overlay, not depth
issues.fix: use a finer, lower-contrast dust structure with soft dark lanes, and spread the stars by brightness so they are not clumped evenly

issues.where: sun corona and prominence, upper right (crops C, Q, R)
issues.what: the prominence loop and corona streaks are smeared and soft, and the disc is flat white with no texture
issues.fix: sharpen the prominence structure and add surface detail plus limb darkening to the disc

issues.where: night-side limb against stars, lower left (crops D, T)
issues.what: the dark limb is a perfectly clean cut-out. The stars stop at a crisp vector-like edge with no faint earthshine or rim detail, which gives away the layering
issues.fix: add a very faint rim and a little terrain relief on the night limb so the edge does not look like a mask

issues.where: sunlit hemisphere centre (crops A, G, Q)
issues.what: the crater field is crisp, but the bright ray systems and bluish patches have a slightly oversharpened HDR halo, and fine detail softens toward the terminator
issues.fix: reduce local-contrast sharpening and keep crater detail resolved into the terminator

issues.where: sky near the sun (crop E top)
issues.what: the warm glow gradient into the black sky shows faint banding
issues.fix: add dither or grain to the glow gradient
